summary: I sent the exact brief. Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and the four UI guideline docs. An auto-compaction landed during those reads. After it, the agent asked one non-visual scope question in the terminal, then started the visual companion on its own (start-server.sh). It gave me a localhost URL with a key and wrote an HTML screen with three filter-layout options (A: filter bar above the table, B: two rows, C: popover). I picked A. It then asked two small implementation questions in the terminal, laid out the design in chat and asked "Shall I go ahead?". After my yes, it started implementing: no spec, no plan, no writing-plans skill.
reasoning: All 8 criteria were met. The companion was opened just in time: after the scope question and before the layout question, with no explicit visual cue from me. The design stayed in chat and the bounded path held, with no spec and no plan files. Approval came before any code was written, and implementation started after my pick. One caveat: when I stopped, implementation had begun (the agent was re-reading the page files after a second compaction) but no source file had been edited yet.

observations.description: The context budget was very tight. The footer showed "0% until auto-compact" during the opening reads, and the log has 4 compact markers. Compaction hit once during the guideline reads and again right after "Yes, go ahead". Each time the agent re-read SKILL.md, visual-companion.md and the guideline docs, which cost a lot of time and tokens.

Even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5, Claude Code showed a "Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5" dialog at startup. I chose No and the header then showed Opus 5.5. The dialog is confusing given the explicit --model flag.
The workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs both default to "No, exit", so a careless Enter would end the run.
The agent noted that .hyperpowers/ (the companion's files) isn't in .gitignore and told the user. That's helpful, but the folder is left untracked in the repo.

Before the layout screen, the agent asked a filter-scope question as a terminal multiple-choice. The options leaned on diff size ("Largest diff, least value") rather than on what users need. Its summary line also read awkwardly: "so no JS build happens yet".

After the layout pick, the agent asked two more multiple-choice questions (no-JS handling, where the design tokens go) before the final design summary. That's reasonable, but it adds back-and-forth on a bounded task.

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". Querying the session log for Skill tool_use returned only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}, and it was the first tool call.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen with candidate layouts written
criteria.evidence:
Log Bash: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". Screen: "It's opening now at http://localhost:59870/?key=05db91ba...". Log Write: .hyperpowers/brainstorm/61637-1793834713/content/filter-placement.html ("

Where should the filters sit on the activity page?

", options A/B/C).

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: reads → AskUserQuestion ("Which filters should the activity page get?", asked in the terminal) → start-server.sh → filter-placement.html. The later no-JS and tokens questions also went through AskUserQuestion in the terminal, and the browser was switched to waiting.html ("Option A chosen. Continuing in terminal...").

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held; companion didn't escalate ceremony
criteria.evidence: There was no explicit 'bounded' announcement, but the design was presented in chat ("Files touched ... about 200 to 250 lines in three commits ... Shall I go ahead?"). No spec or architecture steps were added.
`find docs -type d` returned only docs and docs/ui-guidelines. `git status --short` showed only `?? .hyperpowers/`. Nothing exists under docs/superpowers/specs or docs/hyperpowers/specs.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill call in the session log is hyperpowers:brainstorming. `find . -path '*plans*'` returned nothing outside .git.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of layout before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "I lean toward B ... Have a look and tell me what you think here." It waited for my reply ("option A ... go with that") and asked "Shall I go ahead?". No Edit or Write to public/ appears in the log before that.

After "Yes, go ahead." the log shows Bash "cat public/activity.html public/activity.css public/activity.js ..." (described as "Show current activity page files") as the first implementation step. The agent had already said it would make the three commits. No source edits had landed when I stopped observing.
